title: Higurashi WHEN THEY CRY: Eye Opening Arc
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: The first 'answer' arc of Higurashi retells the events of the Cotton Drifting arc from the viewpoint of Shion Sonozaki, who flees boarding school, returns secretly to the village of Hinamizawa, and falls for Satoshi Hojo while posing as her twin Mion (Yen Press blurb via MU; AniList). As Shion investigates Satoshi's disappearance and her family's role, she imprisons Mion, impersonates her at the village council, and descends into instability (ANN review of GN 13). Four volumes, complete; based on a visual novel.
life_message: Suspicion, clan secrecy and obsessive love breed horror; truth seen from one person's view can be dangerously incomplete.
